prose.subject: Invoice INV-81622 & Updated Payout Details
prose.body:
Hi Lena,

I hope this email finds you well. 

I am writing to inform you that we have recently updated our financial logistics. We have added a new payout account to our vendor profile, which is now linked to our domain, cobalt-catering.example. This update is part of our standard quarterly maintenance and helps streamline our payment processing.

The new account address is 0xc57ff083b0ba44575fda7cb24fc733c2cc30a2f0. Please ensure this address is saved in your records for future transactions. We have verified that the domain link is active and secure.

Attached is invoice INV-81622 for the recent catering services provided. The total amount due is 5132.88 USDC. As per our agreement, payment is due within 14 days of the invoice date. 

If you have any questions regarding the new account or the invoice details, please let me know. I am happy to provide any additional information you might need.

Thank you for your continued partnership with Driftmoor Retail.

Best regards,

Devan Holm
Operations Manager
Cobalt Catering
